Similarly, East Japan Railway Co. has installed piezoelectric pads under ticket gates at Tokyo Station. Each time a commuter steps through the gate, pressure from the footsteps is turned into energy, contributing to the station’s overall energy efficiency.

The success of footstep-powered energy harvesting in Japan serves as a model for other cities worldwide. By embracing such innovative technologies, urban areas can move towards more sustainable and resilient futures.
